premises.text: Most site traffic is infrequent one-shot visitors, while a small share of true fans drive a disproportionate share of page views
premises.evidence_span: more than 84% of a site's traffic visits just once a month or less frequently, with a vast majority only visiting one time ever

premises.text: One True Fan credits fan activity with good-natured gameplay so publishers can identify and connect with their most valuable users
premises.evidence_span: we give them credit, give players credit for their activities, and give them a bit of good natured gameplay. We enable sites to better identify and connect with their most valuable users

premises.text: Users control check-ins and the product never shares complete browsing history
premises.evidence_span: You have complete control over where you check in, if you want to check in automatically on a site, even if Once You're a Fan loads on a site for you. And we never share your complete browsing history anywhere

premises.text: Business model is a loyalty-rewards program for the web, brokering tangible rewards via premier publisher partners without needing millions of installs first
premises.evidence_span: We are going to become the loyalty rewards program for the web

premises.text: Surfaces people who share the same content via Twitter and planned social bookmark integrations
premises.evidence_span: They shared this page via Twitter, and we're starting to pull that information and surface it. And in the coming weeks, we're going to be integrating with Dig, Delicious, Reddit, Tumblr, and more

value.text: Help publishers engage true fans instead of chasing one-shot SEO traffic
value.evidence_span: They would be far better served by engaging their true fans, and that's what my blog, or excuse me, what True Fan is here for
